campaign: Level-4 Priority 3 theorem-supported m-rho stability map
claim_scope: First-order local stability of the origin for the deterministic conditional-mean reference map, per detector family and per window length. No global, nonlinear, cross-distribution, or detector-universal claim is made.
classification_rule: magnitude=|rho(1-GammaTilde)|; BOUNDARY when ||magnitude|-1|<=boundary_tolerance; LOCALLY-STABLE below; LOCALLY-UNSTABLE above

cross_detector_comparison.scope: An empirical ordering between two frozen Gaussian specializations. It is not a detector-universal law and does not extend to the finite-support witnesses, which run at different thresholds.

evidence_boundary: Rigorous interval statements cover only the two exact finite-support witnesses. Frozen infinite-horizon Gaussian CUSUM and Gaussian SR gains remain Monte Carlo estimates and are never labelled certified.
